name: Diff Breakdown

cover.alt: The Diff Breakdown panel, collapsed and expanded, beside the list of change kinds it sorts files into

screenshots.alt: The panel showing a branch's changes as a share bar and one row per kind, from Runtime to Generated
screenshots.caption: A branch's changes, by kind

screenshots.alt: The panel with its groups open, listing each changed file with its folder, lines changed and status
screenshots.caption: Every changed file, grouped

description: See a branch's changes broken down by kind: runtime, tests, contracts, DB migrations, CI/CD, config, dependencies and docs, with each kind's share of the changed lines. Reads repositories on this computer; remote workspaces aren’t supported yet.

settings.title: Compare against
settings.description: Branch or ref to diff against, such as origin/develop. Empty uses the remote's default branch.

settings.title: Auto refresh (seconds)
settings.description: How often the open panel re-reads the changes. 0 refreshes only when you switch workspace or return to the panel.
